resources.string: Notification Keeper

Gmail: on this Googlebook the Gmail app shows the web Gmail and can\'t notify while it\'s closed, so Gmail Go (Google\'s lite Gmail, kept in the background) receives Google\'s new-mail pushes. Notification Keeper shows each of its notifications: it pops up, stays until you deal with it, opens that exact email in the web Gmail when tapped, and its Reply, Delete and Mark as read buttons do that in the web Gmail. Websites and web apps (Chrome, Calendar, Meet, GeForce NOW and others) often take their own notifications back a few seconds after showing them; Notification Keeper puts a quiet copy back so it stays until you tap it or clear it. It also saves Gmail\'s and Gmail Go\'s notification settings and puts them back if they\'re reset. It works in the background on its own - you can close this window any time. It has no internet access and stores no message content.

Notification Keeper: Gmail helper

Carries out your Gmail notification taps and buttons in the web Gmail\'s Inbox: it finds that email there (on older pages too), tapping opens it, and Reply, Delete and Mark as read are picked in the web Gmail\'s own right-click menu for that email. It also clears a Gmail notification once you\'ve opened that email there. It only touches the web Gmail window while it\'s in front, only for this, and stores nothing.
✓ Gmail helper is on: tapping opens the exact email; Reply, Delete and Mark as read work in the web Gmail.
✗ Gmail helper is off: tapping or a button only opens the web Gmail\'s Inbox. Turn on "Notification Keeper: Gmail helper" in Settings → Accessibility.

The Home Depot
Home Depot orders

Home Depot order updates (order confirmed, shipped, out for delivery, delivered, ready for pickup), shown from the order emails Home Depot sends, because the Home Depot app\'s own push notifications never reach this Googlebook. They are shown in addition to your email notification, which still arrives as usual, and they work with any email app on this Googlebook, such as Gmail and Outlook.
